candidates.formal_type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] {n : Nat} (N : Nat) (I : Ideal.{u_1} (MvPolynomial.{0, u_1} (Fin n) k)),
  Ne.{u_1 + 1} I Top.top.{u_1} →
    (∀ (d : Nat) (p : MvPolynomial.{0, u_1} (Fin n) k),
        LE.le.{0} N d → MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.{0, u_1} p d → Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} I p) →
      Etingof.IsIndecomposable.{u_1, u_1} (MvPolynomial.{0, u_1} (Fin n) k)
        (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u_1, u_1} (MvPolynomial.{0, u_1} (Fin n) k) I)

source_text: The quotient representation A/I is indecomposable (in particular, nonzero and admitting no decomposition into two nonzero subrepresentations).
